verses.1: May you become my followers, just as I am a follower of Christ.
verses.2: I praise you for remembering everything I have told you. And as I have given you these instructions, you should keep them in mind.
verses.3: I want you to know that for every man, Christ is the head; for women, it’s the man who is the head. And for Christ himself, God is the head.
verses.4: Every person who prays or prophesies, with his head held high, is considered to be guilty of sin.
verses.5: And every woman who prays or prophesies, her head becomes uncomfortable. For it is the same thing as having a broken head.
verses.6: For if a woman does not cover herself, then I will cover myself too. But if it is shameful for a woman to cover herself or to show off her body, then I will not cover myself.
verses.7: For a man, it is not necessary to cover his head; for the image and glory of God already exist within him. But for a woman, glory is something that belongs to her.
verses.8: For it is not a man who comes from a woman, but a woman who comes from a man.
verses.9: For it is not the man who judges by the woman, but rather the woman who judges by the man.
verses.10: Therefore, a woman deserves to have authority over her own head through these messengers.
verses.11: Neither woman can be separate from man, nor can man be separated from woman in a marriage.
verses.12: For just as a woman is from the man, so too is the man from the woman; and everything comes from God.
verses.13: You should judge yourselves. Is it necessary for women to pray to God without being properly instructed in what to do?
verses.14: Nor does nature teach you that when a man dies, honor remains with him.
verses.15: And if a woman cuts hair, what honor does she gain? It’s because the hair is cut instead of being left as it was.
verses.16: But if anyone thinks that this is a kind act, then we do not have such a habit, nor do the churches of God.
verses.17: But by this, I do not praise it that you did not go to the arena, but to the stadium instead.
verses.18: First of all, as you enter the church, I hear that there are disputes among you. I believe that this is true.
verses.19: For it is also necessary that there be choices among you, so that the standards can become clear to everyone.
verses.20: Therefore, since you are gathered here, it is not proper to eat during this time.
verses.21: Each person chooses their own meal to eat. Some people eat less, while others eat more.
verses.22: For surely, you don’t have a home where you can eat and drink, do you? You also despise the church of God, and you look down on those who don’t have one. What can I say to you? I praise you! But not in this regard.
verses.23: For I received it from the Lord, and I give it to you. The Lord Jesus received bread in the night.
verses.24: And after giving thanks, he said, “This is the body that was given for you. Do this in memory of me.”
verses.25: Also, after eating, use this cup as a reminder of this moment. This is a new ritual in my life. Do this every time you drink, so that you will remember this moment.
verses.26: For if you eat this bread and drink this cup, then you are acknowledging the Lord’s death until that time comes.
verses.27: So, whoever eats the bread or drinks from the lord’s cup in a proper manner, shall be responsible for the body and blood of the lord.
verses.28: One should then test oneself. In this way, one can eat from the food and drink from the cup.
verses.29: For those who eat and drink suffering, they actually suffer and drink that suffering, without realizing that it’s their own body they’re eating and drinking.
verses.30: Therefore, among you there are many who are weak and strong, as well as those who are ready to sleep.
verses.31: But if we judge ourselves, we will not be able to judge others.
verses.32: We were taught by our master, so that we might not be condemned along with the world.
verses.33: So, my brothers, let us go together to eat each other.
verses.34: If anyone asks for food in the house, then give it to them, so that you won’t be brought into punishment. As for the rest, I will arrange everything accordingly.
